scripts.build: npm run build -w functions && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w functions && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:integration: node scripts/ensure-test-secret.mjs && npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-fsm --only auth,firestore,functions "vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.mts"
scripts.emulators: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-fsm
